"What you're seeing behind me is one of multiple locations that have been burning in Kenosha, Wisconsin, over the course of the night," correspondent Omar Jimenez said during his report.

Demonstrations turned deadly on Tuesday night, with two people killed and another injured in incidents that were partly captured on camera.
